value.answer: Depends which football you mean. Soccer: Messi, with eight Ballon d'Or wins and the 2022 World Cup. Ronaldo is the main rival, and fan votes are almost dead even between the two. American football: Tom Brady, with seven Super Bowl titles. Jerry Rice is the name people usually raise against him.
